name: Leather Boots with heel for Women
description: Stylish and durable, these women's leather boots offer the perfect blend of comfort and elegance. Crafted from high-quality leather.

material: Crafted from 100% genuine leather for a luxurious and durable finish.
Soft, supple texture with a natural sheen that enhances with age.
design: Classic lace-up design for a secure and adjustable fit.
Sleek silhouette with minimal stitching for a versatile, modern look.
Available in multiple colors, such as black, brown, and tan, to suit various preferences.
comfort: Padded insole for all-day cushioning and support.
Breathable lining to keep your feet fresh and dry.
Ergonomic arch support for added comfort during long hours of wear.
sole: Durable rubber outsole with anti-slip treads for excellent grip on various terrains.
Lightweight yet sturdy construction for seamless mobility.
durability: Reinforced seams and double-stitch construction to withstand daily wear and tear.
Water-resistant treatment to protect against light rain and splashes.
versatility: Suitable for both casual and semi-formal occasions.
Complements a wide range of outfits, from jeans and a t-shirt to chinos and a blazer.

faq.question: What materials are these boots made from?
faq.answer: Our leather boots are crafted from 100% genuine leather with durable rubber soles.

faq.question: Are these boots waterproof?
faq.answer: They are water-resistant but not fully waterproof.

faq.question: Do they fit true to size?
faq.answer: Yes, but refer to the size chart for accuracy.

faq.question: How do I clean the boots?
faq.answer: Use a damp cloth and apply leather conditioner regularly.

faq.question: Can they be resoled?
faq.answer: Yes, the soles can be replaced by a cobbler.

faq.question: Are the soles slip-resistant?
faq.answer: Yes, the rubber soles provide excellent grip.

faq.question: Do the boots have arch support?
faq.answer: Yes, they are designed with ergonomic arch support.

faq.question: How long does the leather last?
faq.answer: With proper care, the leather can last for years.

faq.question: Are these boots unisex?
faq.answer: Yes, they are designed for both men and women.

faq.question: Is there a warranty?
faq.answer: Yes, a 6-month warranty for manufacturing defects is included.
